limitations: Photo files were header-scanned for dimensions only; no full image semantic analysis; 80 photos were visually sampled once, privately
ZIP font members (.ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2) of 89 archives were read in bounded memory and never extracted; 1 unreadable archive(s) and 36 font member(s) were skipped or failed to parse
Other font formats inside ZIPs were not indexed: .eot 118, .glyphs 8
Nested archives, RAR/7z archives, PDFs and encrypted members were not inspected
HTML message text categorized via deterministic tags; no raw excerpts published
Font name/OS2 embedding permissions are not copyright licenses
License and original creator permissions must be verified before using or redistributing fonts
Font matching based on metadata does not replace rendering a glyph proof sheet

visual_sample_review.sampling: deterministic random selection across available photo headers
visual_sample_review.method: assistant visual review of a local nonpublished thumbnail contact sheet
